## Features
- Move archived conversations and their dedicated subagents to trash. Idle sessions can be processed

immediately.
- Restore conversations to their original workspace, or permanently delete selected tr

ash after confirmation.
- Batch selection, largest-first sorting, per-item results and retries.
- St

orage categories, file types, large files and folder sizes for DSH and a selected workspace.
- In-ap
p GitHub update checks and confirmed upgrades.

## Use
1. Archive a conversation in DSH, then choose **Move to trash** from its menu. Open **Manage archive

s, trash and storage** in plugin details for batches.
2. Review the targets and confirm. **Trash** c
ontains restore and permanent-delete actions. Trash stays until you remove it; uninstalling preserve

s it.
3. Open **Storage overview** and start a DSH or workspace scan. Categories and file types show
where the measured bytes are. Rescanning the same scope keeps the previous result visible until the
ed bytes are. Rescanning the same scope keeps the previous result visible until the new one arrives.
A pending move stays in **Archived**. **Cancel waiting and review** opens a new confirmation to try
again. Permanent deletion removes the selected trash logs and recovery records and cannot be undone.
## Updates
For **v0.0.1**, paste the installation URL above into **Add plugin** once to upgrade to v0.0.3.
The version row checks GitHub daily. Choose **Review update**, then **Confirm upgrade**. When prompt
ed, fully quit DSH and reopen it to load the installed version. You can also add a newer Release URL
through the same plugin manager.
